stories.title: Trezor Warns of Suspected Spy Implant in Crypto Wallet That Could Steal Recovery Phrases
stories.description: Trezor has warned that a suspected hardware implant inside a Trezor Safe 5 could steal recovery phrases and send them over a mobile network.

stories.title: $2 Million+ Drained From Polymarket Traders in New Supply Chain Attack
stories.description: Malicious code linked to a website monitoring tool was designed to hijack logged-in Polymarket sessions and siphon user funds.

stories.title: Max-Severity GitLab Vulnerability Exploited Against Alpine Linux
stories.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-97229, the bug allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on the server.

stories.title: Binance Faces Largest Crypto Heist – $6.36 Billion Reportedly Stolen by North Korean Group
stories.description: Binance reportedly lost $6.36B in a record crypto heist that was linked to North Korea's TraderTraitor group.

stories.title: Unauthorized OpenAI Codex and Claude Code Relays Disable AI Sandboxes and Redirect Enterprise Data
stories.description: A grey market service hijacks Codex and Claude Code settings, routing company data and credentials through its servers across 12 orgs.

stories.title: TeamViewer Flaw Could Let Malicious Hosts Take Over Support Technicians’ Machines
stories.description: An integer overflow tracked as CVE-2026-111585 could be used to execute arbitrary code on the viewer’s system.

stories.title: CISA Warns of GitLab Integer Overflow Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: CISA warned that CVE-2026-97229, a GitLab flaw enabling unauthenticated code execution, is being actively exploited.

stories.title: $6 Billion Binance Hack Bears Hallmarks of North Korea’s TraderTraitor
stories.description: Blockchain analysts link the record crypto theft to North Korean hackers, as Binance probes a possibly compromised engineer laptop.

stories.title: Hackers Actively Exploit Highly Critical Drupal Commerce Core Authorization Bypass Flaw

stories.title: CISA Adds Actively Exploited GitLab RCE and Cisco Firewall DoS Flaws to KEV

stories.title: Binance Suffers Security Breach Affecting $6.3 Billion in Assets, Nearly $3 Billion Frozen
stories.description: Binance says a security incident affected about $6.3 billion in assets, with nearly $3 billion frozen and a DevOps laptop compromise suspected.
